name: Wahoo Fitness
verdict: Atlanta sports-tech company; founder Chip Hawkins and three equal private partners bought it back from its lenders in May 2023 (DC Rainmaker). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Private since the 2023 founder-led buyback (partners: Rhône Group, Jory Capital, RZC Investments — all private). No state or fund owner, no qualifying record. Small chest logo under the UCI badge and a thigh logo on the 2026 kit.
